summary: Iteration 2 frontend verification of Origami PSEO expansion + clients swap. Tested 75 curated routes across home, about/services/work/industries/ai/insights/contact/approach/careers/games and the three NEW PSEO hubs + dynamic children (/build, /solutions, /compare). Result: 75/75 returned expected HTTP (74x200 + /work/fanrush 404). /sitemap.xml now serves 90 <loc> entries (up from 44) and includes build/solutions/compare slugs. Homepage renders all 10 client logos with correct data-testids (hiphopgrails, playsqor, acquire-bet, videoshops, realprofits, getcashback, onlybeaches, nick-cooper, truewrld, wholosophy) and the hero body mentions PlaySQOR; marquee contains 'Fantasy Sports'. /work lists all 10 projects; each new work detail (/work/playsqor, /work/realprofits, /work/getcashback, /work/onlybeaches) renders proper hero/summary/role/stack/highlights + 'Visit live site' link to correct external URL. /build (hub) exposes all 12 stack cards grouped under 5 categories (Mobile/Web/Backend/Data/AI). /compare (hub) + all 6 comparison pages render a clean table (react-native-vs-flutter verified: table with 9 rows). /solutions hub exposes 24 dynamic slugs — sample routes (mobile-app-development-for-real-money-gaming, ai-and-llm-products-for-fintech-and-payments, web-development-for-travel-and-lifestyle, design-and-brand-for-celebrity-and-creator-economy, auctions-and-fan-drops-for-hip-hop-and-music) all 200. New /industries/travel-and-lifestyle renders with OnlyBeaches client; fintech-and-payments lists /work/realprofits + /work/getcashback; hip-hop-and-music no longer references FanRush. Footer NAV_EXTRA contains Solutions, Build with, Compare, Industries, Insights, Approach, Contact. Title duplication (‘| Origami | Origami’) from iteration 1 is FIXED — all sampled titles end with single '| Origami'. No JS errors during navigation (only benign next/image aspect-ratio warnings).

critical_code_review_comments: FanRush eradication is incomplete. Three places in /app/frontend/src/ still reference FanRush: app/layout.js (default site description), app/work/page.js (work metaDescription), components/home/MobileFocusSection.js (visible hero-adjacent copy). Grep: `grep -ri fanrush /app/frontend/src` returns these three hits. User copy on homepage is the user-visible regression.

Homepage 'clients' paragraph in MobileFocusSection.js was hand-typed and diverges from the CLIENTS array in content.js — it should be derived from CLIENTS so future roster changes don’t require source-file edits in two places.

SOLUTIONS is generated by INDUSTRIES.flatMap(services) = 24 combos. This is fine, but there are no per-solution highlights/CTAs beyond service.desc + industry.blurb — content may feel thin for SEO. Consider adding a relatedWork: [] derived from intersecting service.relatedWork with industry.clients.

COMPARES.nextjs-vs-remix maps B.stack='nextjs' and COMPARES.postgres-vs-mongodb maps B.stack='postgres' — placeholder stack slugs (Remix, MongoDB don’t have dedicated /build pages). Either add those stacks or stop rendering a 'Learn more' link for the B side when stack slug duplicates A.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Previous iteration_1 flagged duplicate '| Origami | Origami' title suffix — FIXED in this iteration (titles now clean). Only remaining regression is FanRush residue in 3 files (MobileFocusSection.js copy, layout.js metaDescription, work/page.js metaDescription). Once main agent replaces those strings, retest is a simple curl grep: `curl -s BASE/ BASE/work | grep -ci fanrush` should return 0. rca of the issue: FanRush leak RCA: CLIENTS/PROJECTS arrays in content.js were correctly updated (PlaySQOR replaces FanRush, plus 3 new clients). However three places still hold hand-written string literals that pre-date the CLIENTS array: (a) MobileFocusSection.js defines a hardcoded copy string listing client names instead of deriving from CLIENTS.map(c=>c.name), (b) layout.js has a static site-wide metadata.description naming legacy clients, (c) work/page.js metadata also hand-lists legacy clients. Fix: replace the three string literals OR refactor each to import and join CLIENTS names so future roster changes propagate automatically.
